subject: Banking
title: The Float and Free Money
description: A fast breakdown of The Float and Free Money for builders.

hook.text: When clearing took 3-5 days, the money existed in two places at once. The writer's account and the depositor's bank.

buildup.text: This gap is called float. During float, the money is technically uncollected but often already available to spend.

discovery.text: Banks earned interest on float. Billions of dollars sitting in transit generated free income for financial institutions.

twist.text: Check 21 digitized clearing in 2004, shrinking float from days to hours. Banks lost billions in float income overnight.

climax.text: Float was a hidden subsidy that funded banking for centuries. Faster payments destroyed it.

punchline.text: Money in two places at once. Float was banking's secret income.

quiz.question: What is 'float' in check processing?
options: The time gap where money exists in two accounts during clearing
